prompt: In a vibrant anime style scene set within a bustling fire station bay, the composition is dense with activity and distinct characters. On the far left, a firefighter in a yellow helmet stands firmly, holding a coiled hose that rests on the polished concrete floor. Next to him, a small tabby cat sits calmly, watching the chaos with wide eyes. In the center foreground, a woman in a blue uniform points decisively at a large digital clock mounted high on the wall, her expression urgent. Beside her, a man in a red scarf looks at the clock with concern, his hands clasped tightly. A silver fire truck dominates the mid-ground, its ladder partially extended toward the ceiling. Perched on the truck's bumper is a brown dog, panting happily with its tongue out. To the right of the truck, a young boy in a striped shirt holds a toy fire extinguisher, mimicking the adults around him. Behind the boy, an older man in a gray coat leans against a locker, observing the scene with a gentle smile. A white mug sits on a nearby bench, steam rising from it. A black boot lies abandoned near the bench leg. A clipboard hangs from a hook on the wall, papers fluttering slightly. A pair of glasses rests on top of a stack of manuals on a desk in the background. A green plant in a terracotta pot adds a touch of life to the corner. A red alarm bell is mounted above the main door. A wrench lies on the workbench, gleaming under the lights. A roll of duct tape sits next to the wrench. A flashlight beams across the floor from the hand of a technician in orange overalls. A helmet rests on the seat of a motorcycle parked in the back.
